title: What to Wear to an Indian Wedding in Australia: 2026 Guide
excerpt: What to wear to an Indian wedding in Australia: breathable chanderi, block print cotton and light georgette for summer weddings in Sydney and Melbourne.
body:
For an Indian wedding in Australia, especially during the December to February summer, guests should choose breathable fabrics: chanderi, hand block-printed cotton and Kota Doria for daytime, and light georgette Anarkalis for the evening. Skip heavy velvet and stiff, fully lined lehengas. Bring a light layer for cool evenings and air-conditioned halls.

This guide is for guests in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide, and for family flying in from the UK, US or India, who expect a winter wedding wardrobe and find themselves in the heat.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. Every piece is stitched in our own Jaipur unit, and our block prints are printed by hand by our karigars.*

## What should you wear to an Indian wedding in Australia?

The Indian wedding season, roughly November to February, falls in Australian summer. That changes everything. Heavy fabrics and layered outfits that work in a London or Toronto winter can feel exhausting at an outdoor ceremony in Sydney.

Think light, breathable and colourful. For daytime functions, a chanderi or cotton kurta set is ideal. The [coral pink chanderi kurta set with a hand-embroidered yoke and cutwork dupatta](/products/coral-pink-chanderi-hand-embroidered-kurta-pant-dupatta-set/) ($52) looks festive in bright sunlight and stays comfortable through a long ceremony.

Many Australian Indian weddings include outdoor elements: garden mehndis, vineyard ceremonies, waterfront receptions. Plan for sun, wind and the occasional sudden change in weather.

## How do Australian cities differ for summer weddings?

Australia is big, and the weather varies a lot between cities. Here is a quick guide:

| City | Summer feel | Best fabrics | Tip |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sydney | Warm and humid | Chanderi, cotton, Kota Doria | Avoid heavy linings |
| Melbourne | Changeable, warm days, cool evenings | Georgette, chanderi | Carry a shawl for evening |
| Brisbane | Hot, humid, afternoon storms | Cotton, Kota Doria | Choose quick-drying fabrics |
| Perth | Hot and dry | Cotton, chanderi | Sun protection with your dupatta |
| Adelaide | Hot, dry days | Cotton, georgette | Light layer for evenings |

For humid Sydney or Brisbane days, block-printed cotton is the coolest option. The [grey hand block print cotton kurta set with a Kota Doria dupatta](/products/grey-hand-block-print-cotton-kurta-pant-kota-doria-dupatta-set/) ($52) is soft, breathable and light enough for an outdoor ceremony.

> **From our Jaipur studio:** Jaipur summers are long and hot, so our karigars know which fabrics stay comfortable. Hand block-printed cotton breathes and softens with every wash. Kota Doria has a fine open weave that lets the breeze through. Chanderi gives you a silky sheen without the heat of pure silk. All three are made for weather like an Australian summer.

## What should you wear to each function?

### Mehndi and haldi

Usually daytime, often outdoors. Wear bright cotton in yellow, green or pink. The [mint green hand block print cotton kurta set with a hand-work yoke](/products/mint-green-hand-block-print-cotton-kurta-pant-dupatta-set-with-hand-work-yoke/) ($48) is fresh, light and has enough detail around the neckline for photos.

### Sangeet

Usually in the evening, often in a hall or marquee. A georgette Anarkali gives you movement and looks festive under lights. The [royal blue georgette Anarkali with handwork and gota lace dupatta](/products/royal-blue-georgette-anarkali-suit-gota-handwork-dupatta/) ($52) twirls beautifully and is lighter than taffeta.

### Wedding ceremony

If it is outdoors in the day, choose chanderi or cotton. If it is in a temple or hall, add more embroidery.

### Reception

Evening and usually indoors. This is the time for your most glamorous piece.

This season, pastels with gold thread are a popular choice for Australian summer weddings, as they look fresh in bright sunlight.

## What should you pack for a summer Indian wedding in Australia?

Australian sun is strong, and events can run long. A short carry list:

- A light shawl or wrap for cool evenings and air conditioning
- Sunglasses for outdoor photos between rituals
- Sunscreen for arms and face
- Flat juttis for grass and sand, plus heels for the reception
- A small handheld fan
- Blotting papers for humid days

Keep your dupatta light. A heavy dupatta draped over both shoulders in summer heat quickly becomes tiring.

## Frequently asked questions

**What should I wear to an Indian wedding in Australia in summer?**
Breathable fabrics such as chanderi, block-printed cotton and Kota Doria for daytime, and light georgette Anarkalis for the evening.

**Can I wear a lehenga to an Indian wedding in Australia?**
Yes, but a heavy lehenga can feel very hot outdoors in summer. Save it for an indoor evening reception, or choose a lighter Anarkali.

**What colours work for a summer Indian wedding?**
Pastels, coral, mint, yellow and sky blue look fresh in daylight. Deeper jewel tones work well for evening functions.
